title: Fly to Cusco

weather.note: The big swing begins — warm sunny afternoons, ~4°C nights. Extreme UV: hat + sunscreen by day, warm layer at night.

glance: Early flight to Cusco (5:30 AM hotel departure). Main job is acclimatising — go slow, coca tea, skip alcohol. Gentle orientation walk introduces the old town.

picks.name: Qorikancha
picks.note: Inca Sun Temple with a Spanish church on top; finest stonework in Cusco.

picks.name: Plaza de Armas & San Blas
picks.note: Grand main square, then the steep artisan quarter with the best city views.

picks.name: San Pedro Market
picks.note: Juices, cheeses, chocolate, caldo de gallina; the essential local market.
